name: Simple Hilt
flavor: A simple sword hilt. Nothing special, really.

name: Balanced Hilt
flavor: A simple sword hilt. Very versatile.

name: Push Hilt
flavor: A hilt vertical to the blade. Biomechanically inferior to a normal hilt in terms of reach and leverage, yet still preferred by some.
effect: One-handed; weapon uses Melee Combat Training (Striking) instead

name: Duelist Hilt
flavor: An offensively minded hilt at a slight tilt, made to make disarming an opponent much easier.

name: Caged Hilt
flavor: Shielding the sword wielding hand in some way is an old idea but, like many old ideas, still holds merit this day, so this handle was fitted with a protective basket.
effect: One-handed; Disarming the wielder is at a -20; The wielding hand (location: arm) has +3 armor

name: Ergonomic Hilt
flavor: A handle fitting the wielder's hand very closely and therefore allowing the user to get a much better feel for the weapon's point.
effect: One-handed; Binding is twice as effective.

name: Simple Long Hilt
flavor: A generic two-handed sword hilt offering more leverage than a one-handed hilt.

name: Giant Hilt
flavor: A massive sword hilt. This has no utility for humans and exists more for smiths to boast.

name: Short Shaft
flavor: A generic short shaft that can build the basis for a spear, hammer or axe.

name: Long Shaft
flavor: A shaft perfect for long spears.

name: Twin Shaft
flavor: A double-ended spear shaft allowing for two heads to be mounted. Not as effective individually but some people like the versatility.
effect: Two-handed; allows to add a second weapon point

name: Rifle
flavor: A weapon mount for the tip of a gun. While a little bit outdated, making an improvised spear can be much more effective than using the knife on its own.
effect: Two-handed; -5 to both melee combat rolls and aim actions with the rifle

name: No Blade
flavor: Generally speaking a blade gives great advantages. Sometimes however a blade is simply not available but a stick is still a massive upgrade over fists.
effect: The weapon becomes a simple, primitive club.

name: Knife Blade
flavor: Short, stiff blade. Good penetration, can cut if necessary.
effect: Inconspicuous (when put on a one-handed hilt)

name: Sword Blade
flavor: A long blade that cuts and stabs well.

name: Sword Breaker
flavor: A knife blade with two offshoots to make parrying easier.

name: Sword Whip
flavor: A sword blade that can transform into a whip on command.
effect: Can freely once per combat round swap between a \emph{Sword Blade} and a \emph{Thorn Whip}. It fumbles on any roll of 96+.

name: Inverse Blade
flavor: A curved sword blade with its edge on the inside. Edge alignment is more difficult but cuts become more devastating.
effect: Add Dex to melee damage bonus calculation

name: Plasma Cutter
flavor: A knife-sized blade consisting of finely shaped plasma. Cuts through heat much more than force and thereby is easier to use by weaker people.

name: Chain Blade
flavor: A high-power chainsaw functioning as a sword blade. Why someone invented this, no one knows.

name: Mono Blade
flavor: Advertised as a near mono-molecular edge, this is the sharpest knife blade built yet.

name: Sickle Blade
flavor: An oddly shaped blade that - while having rather short effective range - is incredibly hard to fight against.
effect: parries of 86+ against this weapon always fail

name: Bull Whip
flavor: Leather, woven to a rope, making a bad but dirt cheap weapon.

name: Thorn Whip
flavor: Small thorns along the whip increase the damage against tissue but even thinner armor or thicker clothing will stop the weapon.

name: Shock Whip
flavor: A difficult piece of equipment to create: coils create a strong electric field while staying flexible enough to whip around and not frying itself.

name: No Head
flavor: While a designated weapon point is generally superior to none, no weapon head is superior to no weapon.
effect: The weapon becomes a simple, primitive club.

name: Hammer Head
flavor: A blunt implement originally designed as a tool, later used in a refined form to defeat armor.

name: Telescoping Baton
flavor: A blunt instrument that can be reduced to the size of the hilt.

name: Axe Head
flavor: A very top heavy blade. Good at splitting more so than cutting.

name: Pick Head
flavor: The head on a war pick is designed to defeat armor by breaking through weaker spots. Still works good today.

name: Spiked Head
flavor: Be it spiked mauls or barbed wire around a stick - damage to tissue will be significant.

name: Cup Holder
flavor: A cup holder for your weapon. Why? No reason, really.

name: Bipod
flavor: Legend has it that bipods on knives allow stabbing helicopters to death.
effect: +2 to \emph{Intimidation} if the weapon is visible

name: Dripper
flavor: Stiletto knives delivering toxins are as infamous as they are rare. However some shady individuals do use such weaponry.
effect: Adds an injector to the weapon the applies a prepared dose of an injection type chemical to the target on hit.

name: Shock Wire
flavor: An energy source is added inside the weapon, electrifying it. On an already electrical weapon it is possible to direct the electrical field in a manner that will disrupt energy shielding.
effect: Stun (2); If the weapon already has Stun, it also gains Disrupt.

name: EMP Field
flavor: Coils within the weapon emit an electromagnetic field strong enough to interrupt electronic devices.
effect: When activated as a free action, the weapon gains \emph{EMP} this round. Takes a small fuel cell and 8 actions to recharge.

name: Shotgun
flavor: A single shot 12gauge launcher attached to a hammerhead. It might as well be an improvised explosive device and is as dangerous for the target as for the user and weapon.
effect: Add a single-shot shotgun to the head, increasing damage by 2D10 for one hit. That hit can only be a single or sure strike. Takes 5 actions to reload.

name: Splitter Force Field Generator
flavor: Lovingly dubbed \emph{Ripper Field} by mobsters, this projected force field tears at otherwise stable matter, making it very easy to cut through tough material. The field itself is not very stable however and can only be kept alive for a few seconds.
effect: When activated as a free action, the weapon gains +4 AP for 4 rounds. Takes a small fuel cell and 8 actions to recharge.

name: IED
flavor: An IED on a stick, what do you expect? Quite dangerous, quite destructive.
effect: The weapon gains \emph{Improvised}. An attack with this weapon causes an explosion equal to a 40mm HE grenade, generally destroying the weapon.\\ If the target wears an active PES, only he is hit and the damage is doubled.

name: Rocket Booster
flavor: Everyone understands that a faster weapon point is more destructive. Since too high speeds make edge alignment and controlling the weapon one-handed nearly impossible, it's only safe to use on large blunt weapons.
effect: Allows the wielder to forego a second action to gain D10 additional damage.

name: Thunder Field
flavor: A massive repulsor field - normally used to block mortar fire - is strapped to a club or hammer for some reason. It now lacks precision and battery life but makes up for it by causing additional work for janitors.
effect: When activated as a free action, any target hit and possible targets up to one meter removed are thrown 3D10 meters away from the wielder, reduced by 1 meter per 50kg it weighs. Takes a small fuel cell and 8 actions to reload.
